messages.author: fb4d09b984b22d87
messages.subject: geno.image: change colors, draw plots to map scale
parts:
Dear Karl,

two questions for the geno.image plots:

Q1:
Is it possible to change colors in the geno.image plots?

First, thinking of people with colorblindness, the red/green combination is not ideal.
And second, sometimes, we have colors for different parents which we would want to use in different types of plots for consistency. In such cases, it would be gread, if there would be the option to choose own colors for AA, AB, BB and not rely on the default red, blue, green.

Q2:
Would it be feasible, to draw the figure to map scale (instead of using the consecutive marker order only)? For simplicity, the recombination breakpoint could be drawn in the middle between two markers (when genotypes change from AA to AB or AA to BB).

These are no urgent matters, of course, but would be nice to have.

Best regards
Eva

passed to image() which makes the actual plot.
